clue.text: Survivor fired up again about beginning of challenge

indicators.note: the word for fired up again goes around the other piece

parts.note: a fire lit once more has been relit

indicators.note: the opening letter of the word challenge is taken

explanation.surface: A survivor gets fired up again by the start of a fresh challenge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts C, the first letter of 'challenge', inside RELIT.
explanation.definitionFit: A relict is a thing or species that has survived from an earlier era, a leftover survivor.

clue.text: Saucy nature in caress after a massage

indicators.note: a massage kneads and works things about, so the letters of in caress are worked into a new order

explanation.surface: Some saucy behaviour follows a sensual massage and a caress.
explanation.definitionFit: Raciness is risqué quality, the saucy or slightly indecent character of a joke or story.

clue.text: Fly round pothole, with Polo juddering

indicators.note: something juddering is shaken about violently, so the letters of pothole and Polo are jumbled

explanation.surface: A driver swerves round a pothole while a little Polo car shakes and judders.
explanation.walkthrough: Polo is a small Volkswagen car, which fits the road surface; here it is just letters.
explanation.definitionFit: To loop the loop is an aerobatic manoeuvre: an aircraft flies round a full vertical circle.

clue.text: Baby on a large island

parts.note: a cub is the baby of a bear, lion or fox

explanation.surface: A baby is somewhere on a big island.
explanation.definitionFit: Cuba is the largest island in the Caribbean, so it is a large island by any measure.

clue.text: Dog eats and eats

parts.note: chow is slang for food, eats
again, chow is slang for food

explanation.surface: A greedy dog does nothing but eat and eat.
explanation.definitionFit: The chow chow is a fluffy Chinese breed of dog with a blue-black tongue.

clue.text: Famine, say, harms one that's broke

indicators.note: something broke is smashed up, so the letters of harms one are broken and rebuilt

explanation.surface: Famine harms anyone who is already penniless.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broke' reads as penniless, which suits famine, but signals the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: Famine is one of the Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse in the Book of Revelation, so it is an example.

clue.text: Air passenger's request to relocate wino (wasted)

indicators.note: to relocate is to move things to new places, so the letters of wino and wasted are moved around

explanation.surface: An air passenger asks to move away from a drunk seated next to them.
explanation.definitionFit: A seat beside the cabin window is something a flyer commonly asks for at check-in.

clue.text: May has appalling weather, first of all

indicators.note: the first letter of each of the following words is taken

explanation.surface: The month of May brings terrible weather, above all.
explanation.walkthrough: 'May' looks like the month, but it is the hawthorn's other name.
explanation.definitionFit: May is another name for hawthorn, the shrub whose berry or blossom is also called haw.

clue.text: Eleven in pack?

parts.note: a football eleven is a team; Wolverhampton Wanderers are nicknamed after the animal that hunts in packs, and eleven such animals are a pack

explanation.surface: Is there an eleven in a deck of cards?
explanation.walkthrough: Wolves is the nickname of Wolverhampton Wanderers, an English football club fielding eleven players; the plural animals also run in packs.
explanation.definitionFit: The football team is an eleven, and the animals of the same name famously live in packs.

clue.text: Monkey training

explanation.surface: A monkey being trained.
explanation.definitionFit: The drill is a primate related to the mandrill; drill also means disciplined practice exercises.

clue.text: Club kit

definitions.meaning: to club is to beat or hit hard
clothes or gear, informally in British English

explanation.surface: A sports club's kit.
explanation.definitionFit: To clobber someone is to hit them; clobber is also British slang for one's clothes or gear.

clue.text: Awakening outlaw energised, somewhat knocked about

indicators.note: the run is turned around and read backwards
only some of the letters of outlaw energised are used, a run inside them

explanation.surface: An outlaw, roused into action, gets somewhat beaten up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'somewhat' takes LAWENER from inside 'outlaw energised'; 'knocked about' reverses it.
explanation.definitionFit: A renewal is a revival or rebirth, an awakening of interest or spirit.

clue.text: So, for example, one's written

definitions.meaning: so (soh) is a sung tone of the sol-fa scale, an example of a musical sound
a short written message or memo

explanation.surface: An example: one written down.
explanation.definitionFit: Soh is one tone of the musical scale; a short written message is also called by the same word.

clue.text: Fly down onto vessel

parts.note: feeling down is feeling blue
a bottle is a container or vessel

explanation.surface: A fly lands on a jar.
explanation.definitionFit: A bluebottle is a large blowfly with a metallic blue body.

clue.text: Mother hen in bird, tail of azure blue

indicators.note: the hen piece goes inside the bird

parts.note: the tit is a small songbird
a mother hen sitting on eggs is something that hatches them

indicators.note: the last letter of the word azure

explanation.surface: A mother hen sits inside a bird with a blue tail.
explanation.walkthrough: A hen that sits on eggs hatches them. Blue is the colour of Britain's Conservative Party, so a blue is a Tory, and Margaret Thatcher was its leader.
explanation.definitionFit: A follower of Margaret Thatcher's politics is a Conservative, and Conservatives are called blues in Britain.

clue.text: Meat off? Say no!

parts.note: chicken is a white meat
a light that is off is out

explanation.surface: Someone warns that the meat has gone off and tells you to refuse it.
explanation.definitionFit: To back out of something through cowardice is to decline it, saying no at the last moment.

clue.text: Notice the foam at the mouth

parts.note: to notice something is to see it

explanation.surface: Someone spots froth forming at somebody's mouth.
explanation.definitionFit: Both mean to be furiously angry: seething and foaming with rage are the same idiom of fury.

clue.text: Shilling pocketed by superhero, might one be on strike?

indicators.note: the shilling goes into the superhero as into a pocket

parts.note: Batman is the caped DC Comics superhero
s is the abbreviation for shilling in old British money

explanation.surface: A superhero takes a coin and wonders whether he might join a walkout.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, the batsman facing the bowling is said to be 'on strike'; the surface suggests industrial action.
explanation.definitionFit: In cricket the player currently facing the bowler is the one on strike.

clue.text: Fresh punishment

definitions.meaning: a brisk, lively breeze is called ...

explanation.surface: A new form of discipline.
explanation.definitionFit: A spanking breeze is fresh and brisk; a spanking is also a smacking given as a punishment.

clue.text: Shelter man and boy punched by queen

indicators.note: the queen breaks into the middle of the other letters as a punch would

parts.note: a son is a boy child
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the queen's royal cipher

explanation.surface: A man and a boy in a shelter are assaulted by a queen.
explanation.walkthrough: ER is Elizabeth Regina. The Anderson shelter was a backyard air-raid shelter in wartime Britain, named after Home Secretary John Anderson.
explanation.definitionFit: Sir John Anderson gave his name to the corrugated-iron garden air-raid shelter of the Second World War.

clue.text: Gripping tool designed to pick mushrooms, quite possibly?

parts.note: a tool designed for a job is for it
ceps are wild porcini mushrooms, given as one possible kind

explanation.surface: A gripping tool made for gathering mushrooms, perhaps.
explanation.definitionFit: Forceps are pincers or tongs used by surgeons to grip and hold things.

clue.text: Tintin's kicking performance

parts.note: split the cartoon reporter's name into tin and tin, each a can, and a high-kicking Parisian dance appears

explanation.surface: The boy reporter Tintin is putting on a show with high kicks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tintin' looks like the cartoon reporter, but splits into TIN + TIN, and a tin is a can, so the dance's name doubles that word.
explanation.definitionFit: The high-kicking dance of Paris music halls is named by doubling the word for a tin container.

clue.text: Wife, loveliest woman in the States?

parts.note: a beauty-contest winner is a Miss, crowned as the loveliest
the US is the United States

explanation.surface: A man asks if his wife is the most beautiful woman in America.
explanation.definitionFit: Missus is an informal word for one's wife.

clue.text: Ordinary part of a rifle

definitions.meaning: the wooden butt and handle of a gun

explanation.surface: An ordinary rifle component.
explanation.definitionFit: A stock phrase is a standard, ordinary one; the stock is also the shoulder end of a rifle.

clue.text: Knock up designer range: time to impress Penny

indicators.note: to impress is to press in, so the penny goes inside
a designer arranges things anew, so the letters of range and time are rearranged

explanation.surface: A designer cooker range is advertised: time to wow Penny.
explanation.walkthrough: 'designer' rearranges RANGE and TIME into IMREGNATE; 'to impress' presses P into it.
explanation.definitionFit: To knock up is slang for to make pregnant, which is what impregnate means.

clue.text: Idea spread by twin setters

indicators.note: twin means two identical copies of the piece

parts.note: a crossword setter refers to themselves as me

explanation.surface: An idea is put about by a pair of twin crossword setters.
explanation.walkthrough: 'twin' doubles ME, the setter's word for themselves.
explanation.definitionFit: A meme is an idea or image that spreads from person to person, now often online.

clue.text: Group of patriots

indicators.note: part of means some letters are taken from the word patriots

explanation.surface: A band of patriots.
explanation.definitionFit: A trio is a group of three, especially of musicians.

clue.text: Milanese men, say, of dubious origins

indicators.note: something dubious is questionable or not straight, so the letters of origins are rearranged

explanation.surface: Some men from Milan have a shady background.
explanation.definitionFit: Signori is Italian for gentlemen, the plural of signor, so men in Milan would be called this.

clue.text: Lifting bumper, type of fastener

indicators.note: in a down light, lifting makes the word read upwards, backwards

parts.note: a bumper crop is a big one

explanation.surface: A car bumper is lifted to fit a kind of fastener.
explanation.definitionFit: A gib is a metal wedge or bolt used to hold parts of a machine together.

clue.text: More than one top vehicle fails

parts.note: a car is a road vehicle
an engine that fails dies

explanation.surface: A first-rate car breaks down, more than once.
explanation.walkthrough: 'top' looks like an adjective meaning best, but it is a garment.
explanation.definitionFit: Cardies is informal British for cardigans, knitted tops, and the plural covers more than one.

clue.text: Damage sea boat struggling to keep going, initially

indicators.note: to keep is to hold within, so the first letter goes inside
a struggling boat is thrown about, so the letters of sea boat are mixed
the first letter of the word going

explanation.surface: A boat is damaged at sea and struggles to stay afloat from the start.
explanation.walkthrough: 'struggling' mixes SEA BOAT into SABOTAE; 'to keep' holds G, from 'going' 'initially', inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Sabotage is deliberate damage to equipment or plans, used here as a verb meaning wreck.

clue.text: Sacred book about European, Asian

indicators.note: the holy book goes around the other letter

parts.note: the Koran is the holy book of Islam

explanation.surface: A holy book about a European, written by an Asian.
explanation.definitionFit: Korea is in East Asia, so a person from there is an Asian.
